title: Website & SaaS login
tagline: Eliminate passwords, reset flows, and SMS 2FA costs.
problem: Password databases leak, users reuse passwords everywhere, and every reset or SMS code costs support time and money.
solution: Show a Digi-ID QR code on the login page. The user scans, approves, and the callback signs the browser session in. You store one public address per user.
benefits: Nothing secret to steal from your database
No password resets or SMS fees
Faster sign-in on desktop and mobile
Works next to existing passwords during migration
flow: Server verifies and upgrades the session

title: Checkout without accounts
problem: Forced account creation is a top reason for abandoned carts, yet guest checkout loses the returning-customer relationship.
solution: Offer “Continue with Digi-ID” at checkout. The address becomes the customer ID; ask only for the shipping details you actually need.
benefits: One-scan return visits
No password to forget between orders
Collect only the data you need
Order history without a password database
flow: Store links the order to the address
Next visit: scan once to see orders

title: Gaming accounts
tagline: Bind player assets and profiles directly to wallet signatures.
problem: Ranks, items and years of progress are lost to phishing, credential stuffing and forgotten passwords.
solution: Use Digi-ID as the primary login or as a strong second factor for trades and account changes. Keys never leave the player's phone.
benefits: Phishing-resistant: signatures are bound to your domain
No password to reuse or leak
Confirm high-value actions with a scan
Works for launchers, web portals and consoles with QR display
flow: Session token issued to the launcher
cta: Try it: Secure a player account

title: Doors, lockers & IoT
tagline: Replace swipe cards with a scan.
problem: Access cards get lost, cloned and shared; changing who can enter means reissuing hardware.
solution: Put a small screen at each door showing a fresh, short-lived Digi-ID challenge. One callback serves every door; the server knows which door issued each nonce, checks the address against that door's allow-list and triggers the lock.
benefits: No cards to issue or revoke
Per-door audit trail by address
Revoke access instantly in software
Short challenge lifetime defeats photographed codes
flow: Door screen shows a per-door QR code
Lock opens and the event is logged

title: Identity & age checks
tagline: Cryptographically prove returning status without re-entering personal data.
problem: Users upload the same ID documents to service after service, creating copies of sensitive data everywhere.
solution: After a one-time verification, a trusted verifier links the result to the user's Digi-ID address for your service. Later visits just prove control of that address.
benefits: Stop re-collecting documents
Store a verification flag, not a passport scan
Hard to forge or share
Pseudonymous by default
flow: User completes a one-time ID check
Verifier records the address as verified
Later, user signs in with Digi-ID

title: Internal tools & admin panels
tagline: Strong sign-in without an identity-provider bill.
problem: Small teams run dashboards, CMS back-ends and staging servers with shared or weak passwords.
solution: Allow-list staff addresses and require a Digi-ID scan to reach admin routes. Remove an address to revoke access immediately.
benefits: No shared admin passwords
Instant revocation
Free and self-hosted
Easy to add in front of existing tools

title: Forums & communities
problem: Communities fight spam sign-ups and account takeovers while members want privacy.
solution: Let members link a Digi-ID to their forum account and sign in by scanning. Each forum sees a different address, so members can't be tracked across sites.
benefits: No email or phone required to sign in
Per-site addresses protect privacy
Account takeover via leaked passwords is gone
Plugins exist for phpBB and WordPress
flow: Member links Digi-ID in their profile
Login page shows a QR code

title: Events & check-in
tagline: Dynamic ticket authentication that prevents screenshot fraud.
problem: PDF and screenshot tickets are easy to duplicate and resell; check-in lines are slow.
solution: Bind each ticket to the buyer's Digi-ID address. At the gate a screen shows a challenge; the attendee scans and the ticket is checked against the signed address.
benefits: Tickets tied to a key, not an image
Fast gate check-in
Transfer by re-binding to a new address
No attendee personal data needed at the gate
flow: Buyer links a ticket to their address
Server marks the ticket as used
